title: Signed Binomial Sum for Krawtchouk Values
statement: Let $n,z,j$ be nonnegative integers with $z\le n$, and let $K_{n,j}$ be the Krawtchouk polynomial. Then $K_{n,j}(z)=\sum_{k=0}^{j}(-1)^k\binom{z}{k}\binom{n-z}{j-k}$.
